stem.dinolab.catalog_intro: Follow a trait, a place, or a question. Save specimens to revisit as your ideas develop.
stem.dinolab.outside_filters: This open specimen is outside your current filters.
stem.dinolab.specimen_empty: Open a specimen to explore its traits, fossil evidence, and unanswered questions.
stem.dinolab.guide_explain: Ask how the fossils support an explanation.
stem.dinolab.guide_record: Write what you know and what you still wonder.
stem.dinolab.save_first_hint: Open a species file and choose Save specimen to begin your collection.
stem.dinolab.change_filters_hint: Try a broader search or reset the filters to see the full collection.
stem.dinolab.device_motion_paused: Motion is paused by your device preference.
stem.dinolab.motion_paused_help: Motion paused. You can still rotate and zoom.
stem.dinolab.motion_help: Pause breathing, feather movement, and auto spin.
stem.dinolab.studio_note: Studio lighting shows form; habitat scenes and surface colors are interpretations.
stem.dinolab.overlap_caution: Their estimated age ranges overlap. Local habitat and more precise dating would be needed to test whether they shared an ecosystem.
stem.dinolab.time_gap: Their known time ranges are separated by about
stem.dinolab.same_specimen: You have selected the same species twice. Choose a different species to investigate a contrast.
stem.dinolab.notebook_download_failed: The notebook could not be downloaded. Your notes are still in this activity.
stem.dinolab.notebook_intro: Separate what you notice from what you infer. Notes stay with this activity; download a copy to keep independently.
stem.dinolab.notes_retained: Changes are kept in the activity as you type.
stem.dinolab.notebook_empty: Start with a question. A specimen appears here when you begin writing.
stem.dinolab.evidence_distinction: “The fossil has curved claws” describes evidence. “It may have gripped prey” is an inference. A model helps explore an idea, but does not prove the behavior.
stem.dinolab.science_changes: Science updates as new fossils turn up. Changing an explanation when the evidence changes is part of the work.
stem.dinolab.path_hint: Start with a species below, or choose a route through time, fossils, and reconstruction.
